build_fuse_gmock: build fused gmock and gtest headers and source into a single output directory
create_fused_gmock_h: create a fused gmock/gmock.h header by scanning gmock root and resolving all includes
create_fused_gmock_gtest_all_cc: create a fused gmock-gtest-all.cc file combining gtest and gmock source
test_validate_gmock_root: test that a gmock root directory contains the required seed files and valid structure
review_fuse_gmock_main: review the main CLI entry point that accepts gmock root and output directory arguments
